title: _tools/aliases.csv maps the other names of the SP-qjn563cf research topics (ort, MMLW, Fluent, Oxigraph, zen-engine, OTel, JSON Lines, GLiNER, Morfeusz)
goal: _tools/aliases.csv holds the 48 term,canonical rows the SP-qjn563cf goal research worker wrote for its 14 new topics and could not land (outside its touches); the rows are in this item's notes, each checked against the canonical term its article uses, and a pack for an alias names the topic's article.

run: import csv,sys;have={r['term'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('_tools/aliases.csv',encoding='utf-8'))};want=[x.strip() for x in 'mmlw;polish embeddings;pirb;fluent-rs;fluent.js;ftl;fluent translation list;rdf store;sparql store;triple store;quad store;named graph;oxigraph server;tsdb;openmetrics;jdm;zen engine;gorules zen;zen expression language;brms;coreference resolution;anaphora resolution;coref;ort crate;ort-rs;pykeio ort;onnx runtime;grafana loki;grafana tempo;otlp;otel collector;otelcol;ocb;jsonl;ndjson;newline-delimited json;jcs;content-addressed;sha-256;zero-shot ner;zero-shot relation extraction;gliner multi;gliner-x;morfeusz 2;sgjp;polimorf;lemmatization;lematyzacja'.split(';')];miss=[w for w in want if w not in have];print(len(want),'terms wanted, missing',len(miss));sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)

import csv,glob,sys;t=' '.join(open(p,encoding='utf-8').read().lower() for p in glob.glob('kb/public/**/*.md',recursive=True));terms=set('mmlw;polish embeddings;pirb;fluent-rs;fluent.js;ftl;fluent translation list;rdf store;sparql store;triple store;quad store;named graph;oxigraph server;tsdb;openmetrics;jdm;zen engine;gorules zen;zen expression language;brms;coreference resolution;anaphora resolution;coref;ort crate;ort-rs;pykeio ort;onnx runtime;grafana loki;grafana tempo;otlp;otel collector;otelcol;ocb;jsonl;ndjson;newline-delimited json;jcs;content-addressed;sha-256;zero-shot ner;zero-shot relation extraction;gliner multi;gliner-x;morfeusz 2;sgjp;polimorf;lemmatization;lematyzacja'.split(';'));rows={r['term']:r['canonical'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('_tools/aliases.csv',encoding='utf-8'))};bad=sorted(t2 for t2 in terms if t2 in rows and rows[t2].lower() not in t);print('canonical terms no article uses:',bad);sys.exit(1 if bad or not terms<=set(rows) else 0)

import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','What is ndjson?'],capture_output=True,text=True); o=r.stdout; ok=r.returncode==0 and o.startswith('coverage: good') and 'check:' not in o and '## public/arch/content-addressed-ids-jsonl.md' in o; print('alias ndjson pack leads with the JSON Lines article and no check line:',ok); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Rows (term,canonical): mmlw,mmlw-e5; polish embeddings,mmlw-e5; pirb,polish information retrieval benchmark; fluent-rs,fluent; fluent.js,fluent; ftl,fluent; fluent translation list,fluent; rdf store,oxigraph; sparql store,oxigraph; triple store,oxigraph; quad store,oxigraph; named graph,oxigraph; oxigraph server,oxigraph; tsdb,prometheus; openmetrics,prometheus; jdm,json decision model; zen engine,zen-engine; gorules zen,zen-engine; zen expression language,zen-expression; brms,business rules management system; coreference resolution,coreference; anaphora resolution,coreference; coref,coreference; ort crate,onnxruntime; ort-rs,onnxruntime; pykeio ort,onnxruntime; onnx runtime,onnxruntime; grafana loki,loki; grafana tempo,tempo; otlp,opentelemetry protocol; otel collector,opentelemetry collector; otelcol,opentelemetry collector; ocb,opentelemetry collector builder; jsonl,json lines; ndjson,json lines; newline-delimited json,json lines; jcs,json canonicalization scheme; content-addressed,content addressing; sha-256,sha256; zero-shot ner,gliner; zero-shot relation extraction,glirel; gliner multi,gliner_multi-v2.1; gliner-x,gliner-x-base; morfeusz 2,morfeusz; sgjp,morfeusz; polimorf,morfeusz; lemmatization,lemmatisation; lematyzacja,lemmatisation. Broad ones (tsdb, named graph, sha-256, brms) may misroute: drop any a pack shows misrouting. Four canonicals no kb/public article spells yet (business rules management system, json canonicalization scheme, opentelemetry collector builder, opentelemetry protocol): use the article's own term (the canonical check fails until then). Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 2 of 19, "Lookup correctness: router experts, the tag parser and aliases answer what the kb holds"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. rag.py eval passes before the work: it pins that no alias misroutes a row.
